newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares drop amid quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares drop amid quiet trade.

text.p: The small Estonian stock exchange was slow on Thursday with prices falling and the main official list turnover at just 5.2 million kroons, dealers said.
The stock exchange index dropped 0.43 per cent to 108.76.
Shares in Forexpank turned over 1.9 million kroons and closed lower at 75.85 versus 76.50. Tallinna Pank had volume of 1.2 million kroons and ended unchanged at 39.30 kroons.
The secondary over-the-counter market saw a low volume of 3.2 million kroons, which the Rakvere meat processor dominated with trade of more than 1.6 million kroons.
It closed slightly lower at 5.85 kroons versus 6 kroons.
